routing: When frame alignment is lost, the unit applies the G.798 consequent actions: an ODU alarm indication signal is inserted downstream on every ODU the OTU carries, and a backward defect indication is sent to the far-end transmitter.
troubleshooting_notes: Errors on one channel only, with the optical path and the neighbouring channels normal, point to the receiver.
Errors on every channel of a line point to the line, not to the interfaces.
